decision: Decision, 2026-10-28 (refined 2026-10-29): every pending set, by set and lab and never by row, gets one role before any residual is used for training: train, calibrate (sets the uncertainty), locked test (used once, at the end) or record (no fit or uncertainty uses it now)

rules.record: the level and constants tables, widths, lifetimes, other states and theory; sets whose rows the third blind test marks mostly seen or superseded (an active set prints them); constants fitted to intervals held as an observation set; the atlas constants tables
rules.train: the atlas line lists; every set beyond the core (B v' > 43 or X v'' > 17), whose blind test is pending_blind_v3; the sets of other isotopologues not drawn for the locked test
rules.locked_test: lab families with no data in training and not a compilation, in the seeded random order below, each with all its open sets, while every stratum it touches stays within 20 % and one is under 15 %; beyond-core families are skipped. Target: 15-20 % of the rows of the non-compilation sets in the core and isotopologue strata
